claims.Finding: Main actor update loads global delta717480 into XMM6 and calls3C6740(Actor+344,delta). Actor+292 bit0x400000 skips this call but not later motion maintenance/movement.

claims.Finding: Advance clears accumulated root delta, then increments frame by delta*speed, handles blend completion, endpoint/loop transitions,4-entry motion queue and frame-trigger callbacks.

claims.Finding: Motion resource switch resolves BAR type9 motion and type16 trigger entries, cleans old refs/effects/blend state, updates duration and frame/blend fields, and primes triggers.
claims.Limitations: Assumes valid entries in several paths; arbitrary pointers/IDs are unsafe.

claims.Finding: Searches four named motion variants, decodes resource pointers and activates3C8A40; manages optional shared reference counter+432. Missing resource clears motion after cleanup.
claims.Limitations: Needs current actor/model resource set; missing resources have meaningful destructive side effects.

claims.Finding: Pose submission selects normal motion or interpolation snapshots using frame/blendDuration and synchronizes motion attributes attached to bones.
claims.Limitations: Depends on actor render object+1968 and loaded skeleton.

claims.Finding: Processes pending pose/blend setup, allocates model snapshots, resets previous root sample when needed, updates root-motion deltas and linked effects.
claims.Limitations: Still runs in actor/effect freeze; not a pure read/update-frame helper.

claims.Finding: Samples root matrix through virtualslot40, computes delta from previous root sample+236, accumulates+252 translation/yaw delta and normalizes angle.
claims.Limitations: Directly jumping frame may create a large root-motion displacement; frame writes require reset/replay semantics.

claims.Finding: Sets blend duration/target frame, starts transition frame2 and expands controller AABB to contain new motion bounds.
claims.Limitations: ABI RCX controller,XMM1 blendDuration,XMM2 targetFrame; current motion must exist.

claims.Finding: Appends a motion queue record in a4-slot ring with motionID,blend,startframe and optional callback.
claims.Limitations: No overflow protection shown; not an external arbitrary queue interface.

claims.Finding: Frees both controller blend snapshots using current scene heap and clears their pointers.
claims.Limitations: Stale scene heap/model pointers are unsafe.

claims.Finding: Releases shared motion refcount, stops8 attached sound handles, marks linked effects for deletion and invokes completion callback.
claims.Limitations: Motion switch/reset is not a harmless visual-only operation.

claims.Finding: Evaluates frame-range motion triggers, invoking handler for active start<=frame<end or endFFFF.
claims.Limitations: Holding time can keep active trigger intervals active; animation freeze is not damage immunity.

claims.Finding: Invokes point triggers crossed between old and new frame, with special negative-end mode for exact start.
claims.Limitations: Rewind/seek needs defined trigger policy; plain frame assignment can skip or repeat gameplay effects.

claims.Finding: Script command writes float bits argument+8 to decoded actor+680 (controller+336 speed).

trainerContract.speedProposal: Per-actor playback rate can use float+0x2A8 with compare-restore lease bound to actor, status backlink, scene heap/scheduler/MapTarget,model+1968,current motion and resource. Proposed policy0..3 finite, not an engine-established limit. Zero holds time in the current motion but does not guarantee actor or AI freeze.

Do not mutate shared motion resource headers for a per-player effect.
Actor+292 bit0x400000 skips delta reset along with advance; stale displacement may persist.
